name: SnapEDA Parts Search
description: Search SnapEDA and import symbols, footprints, and 3D models.
description_full: A KiCad 10 PCB Editor IPC action that searches SnapEDA parts and imports symbol, footprint, and 3D model assets. Linux is the supported platform. Requires a Python interpreter with KiCad's wxPython runtime and curl_cffi; these are not installed by PCM.
